title: Concept: Database schema dump in a response
description: Table definitions with columns and keys in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The schema names every table and column, which is the vocabulary an attacker needs to write a working injection instead of guessing field names.
applicability: Deployments that render table definitions with columns and keys into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The schema names every table and column, which is the vocabulary an attacker needs to write a working injection instead of guessing field names.
